text:
elaine: Heads up — courier says they'll drop off 4 boxes Saturday between 11–1. Where should we stage them? Also conference table needed for UX interns — anyone up for a seat swap? :package:
frontdesk-bot: Delivery scheduled: CourierCo (tracking: CC12345), ETA Sat 11:30. Front desk open 9–12 on Saturday. @elaine if you want us to sign, we'll hold in the lobby.
todd: I can grab them and put in the shipping closet at 11:45. Leaving a note on the door. :white_check_mark:
jeff: Shipping closet's pretty full — can we use Conf B instead? I'll put a 'Do not move' sign. Seats needed: I'll give up my hotdesk for the afternoon (2–5).
anya: I'll take jeff's seat 2–5. +1 for Conf B. Also can someone list package contents? Fragile?
elaine: Contents: 2 monitor stands, 1 router (fragile foam inside), 1 box of swag. Not fragile except router. I'll bring foam if needed.
todd: Cool. I'll label the router as fragile and leave foam in the closet. Quick poll: anyone opposed to using Conf B for the interns Sat 1–4? react with :thumbsup: to approve, :thumbsdown: to decline.
jeff: :thumbsup:
anya: :thumbsup:
mike: If Conf B is used, can we move the AV cart out? I need it for Sunday. Will return Sunday evening. @todd ok?
todd: Yep I'll put the cart in storage room 2.
frontdesk-bot: Reminder: package pickup by sender after 7 days. If you need long-term storage, file a ticket: https://redwood.intra/ops-packages
elaine: Thanks all — plan: Conf B for staging, todd to handle pickup/labeling, jeff trades seat with anya. @frontdesk-bot can you print a sign 'Interns — Saturday 1–4' and put on the conf room door?
frontdesk-bot: Sign request logged (ticket #5643). Printing and placing at 11:15 Sat.
